newsitem.title: UK: LME copper dives below key support.
newsitem.headline: LME copper dives below key support.

text.p: The price of London Metal Exchange (LME) three months copper crumbled on major fund liquidation, diving under key support of $1,970 per tonne, dealers said.
At 1435 GMT, copper was trading at $1,951, down $69 from Wednesday's afternoon kerb close.
Last Friday prices rallied above the $1,970 level, a key barrier which had capped the market since mid-June, and was expected to offer a floor to the market this week.
But early selling in thin volume on Thursday took copper down below $1,970 at which point buy-stops were triggered and it tumbled.
Spreads have eased dramatically, with the premium for cash delivery over three months indicated at $7/$8 compared to $60 last Friday.
